name: greek-lowercase-delta
draw: Lowercase Greek delta (δ): a round bowl at the bottom with a hooked stroke curling up and over from its top left like a small ascender.

name: greek-lowercase-omega
draw: Lowercase Greek omega (ω): a wide rounded w made of two joined bowls open at the top.

name: greek-lowercase-sigma
draw: Lowercase Greek sigma (σ): a round bowl with a short straight stroke running out to the right from its top.

name: greek-final-sigma
draw: Greek final sigma (ς): a c shape whose lower end curls down into a small hook below the baseline.

name: greek-theta-symbol
draw: Greek theta symbol, the cursive theta (ϑ): a stroke rising in a tall loop on the left that sweeps over the top and down the right side into a small open hook.

name: greek-koppa
draw: Archaic Greek koppa (Ϙ): a round circle sitting on top of a short straight vertical stem.

name: greek-sampi
draw: Greek sampi (ϡ): a large curved stroke arching over and down to the lower left with two short parallel diagonal strokes hanging inside it.

name: greek-stigma
draw: Greek stigma (ϛ): a final sigma like c with a small tail flicking right from its top and a long hook curling below the baseline.

name: cyrillic-be
draw: Cyrillic capital Be (Б): a vertical stem with a flat top bar reaching right and a closed bowl at the lower right.

name: cyrillic-ghe
draw: Cyrillic capital Ghe (Г): a vertical stem with a single horizontal arm across the top to the right, like an upside down L.

name: cyrillic-ghe-with-upturn
draw: Cyrillic capital Ghe with upturn (Ukrainian) (Ґ): an upside down L whose top arm ends in a short upward tick at the right.

name: cyrillic-ghe-with-stroke
draw: Cyrillic capital Ghe with stroke (Ғ): an upside down L with a short horizontal bar crossing the stem at mid height.

name: cyrillic-de
draw: Cyrillic capital De (Д): a narrow frame with a slanted left side and upright right side standing on a wide base bar whose ends drop as two short feet.

name: cyrillic-i
draw: Cyrillic capital I (И): a mirrored N, two vertical stems joined by a diagonal running from bottom left to top right.

name: cyrillic-short-i
draw: Cyrillic capital Short I (Й): the mirrored N shape topped by a small curved breve.

name: cyrillic-el
draw: Cyrillic capital El (Л): a flat top bar on a straight right leg and a left leg that curves outward at the foot.

name: cyrillic-pe
draw: Cyrillic capital Pe (П): two vertical stems joined by a flat bar across the top, like an open doorway.

name: cyrillic-tse
draw: Cyrillic capital Tse (Ц): a squared U with a flat base whose lower right corner extends into a short descender tail.

name: cyrillic-che
draw: Cyrillic capital Che (Ч): a short left stem bending into a bar at mid height that joins a tall right stem, like an upside down h.

name: cyrillic-sha
draw: Cyrillic capital Sha (Ш): three vertical stems joined by a flat base, like a comb with three teeth pointing up.

name: cyrillic-shcha
draw: Cyrillic capital Shcha (Щ): the three pronged Sha with a short descender tail hanging from its lower right corner.

name: cyrillic-hard-sign
draw: Cyrillic capital Hard Sign (Ъ): a short top bar at the left joined to a vertical stem with a closed bowl at the lower right.

name: cyrillic-soft-sign
draw: Cyrillic capital Soft Sign (Ь): a plain vertical stem with a closed bowl at the lower right and nothing at the top.

name: cyrillic-yeru
draw: Cyrillic capital Yeru (Ы): a stem with a bowl at the lower right followed by a separate tall vertical bar on the right.

name: cyrillic-e
draw: Cyrillic capital E (Э): a backwards C opening to the left with a short horizontal bar across its middle.

name: cyrillic-yu
draw: Cyrillic capital Yu (Ю): a vertical stem on the left joined by a short bar to a tall oval on the right.

name: cyrillic-ya
draw: Cyrillic capital Ya (Я): a mirrored R: a bowl at the upper left, a stem on the right and a diagonal leg kicking out to the lower left.

name: cyrillic-yo
draw: Cyrillic capital Yo (Ё): an E with three horizontal arms topped by two dots side by side.

name: cyrillic-ukrainian-ie
draw: Cyrillic capital Ukrainian Ie (Є): a C opening to the right with a short horizontal bar across its middle.

name: cyrillic-yi
draw: Cyrillic capital Yi (Ukrainian) (Ї): a single vertical stem with two dots side by side above it.

name: cyrillic-dje
draw: Cyrillic capital Dje (Serbian) (Ђ): a T shaped top bar whose stem has a humped arm on the right that curves down into a hook below the baseline.

name: cyrillic-tshe
draw: Cyrillic capital Tshe (Serbian) (Ћ): a T shaped top bar whose stem has a humped arm on the right ending straight at the baseline, like an h.

name: cyrillic-lje
draw: Cyrillic capital Lje (Љ): the El shape joined on its right to a stem with a closed bowl at the lower right.

name: cyrillic-nje
draw: Cyrillic capital Nje (Њ): an H whose right stem carries a closed bowl at the lower right.

name: cyrillic-dzhe
draw: Cyrillic capital Dzhe (Џ): a squared U of two stems and a flat base with a short stem dropping from the centre of the base.

name: cyrillic-short-u
draw: Cyrillic capital Short U (Belarusian) (Ў): a y like shape with a short left arm meeting a long right stroke that sweeps into a tail, topped by a curved breve.

name: cyrillic-yat
draw: Historic Cyrillic capital Yat (Ѣ): a tall stem crossed near the top by a horizontal bar, with a closed bowl at the lower right.

name: cyrillic-en-with-descender
draw: Cyrillic capital En with descender (Kazakh) (Ң): an H whose lower right corner extends into a short descender tail.

name: cyrillic-big-yus
draw: Historic Cyrillic capital Big Yus (Ѫ): a small triangle on top of a wide horizontal bar, with a central stem and two splayed legs below the bar.

name: cyrillic-little-yus
draw: Historic Cyrillic capital Little Yus (Ѧ): a tall A shape with a short vertical stem hanging from the centre of its crossbar.

name: cyrillic-ksi
draw: Historic Cyrillic capital Ksi (Ѯ): a 3 like double bowl with a small check mark above and a tail curling below the baseline.

name: hebrew-bet
draw: Hebrew letter bet (ב): a squared backwards C open to the left, with a flat roof, a right wall and a base that juts slightly past the wall.

name: hebrew-gimel
draw: Hebrew letter gimel (ג): a narrow upright stroke with a small head at the top and a short foot kicking out to the lower left.

name: hebrew-dalet
draw: Hebrew letter dalet (ד): a wide flat roof that overhangs a single right leg dropping straight down, with a sharp top right corner.

name: hebrew-he
draw: Hebrew letter he (ה): a flat roof on a full right leg, with a shorter left leg floating below the roof leaving a gap at the top left.

name: hebrew-vav
draw: Hebrew letter vav (ו): a single vertical stroke with a small head tipping to the left at the top.

name: hebrew-zayin
draw: Hebrew letter zayin (ז): a vertical stroke topped by a short horizontal head that overhangs on both sides.

name: hebrew-het
draw: Hebrew letter het (ח): a flat roof resting on two full length legs with no gap, like a doorway.

name: hebrew-tet
draw: Hebrew letter tet (ט): a rounded cup open at the top whose left arm curls inward into a small hook.

name: hebrew-yod
draw: Hebrew letter yod (י): a small comma like stroke hanging from a tiny head.

name: hebrew-kaf
draw: Hebrew letter kaf (כ): a rounded backwards C open to the left, curved top and bottom strokes joined by a right curve.

name: hebrew-lamed
draw: Hebrew letter lamed (ל): a short stem rising high on the left that turns into a horizontal stroke and curves down into a hook on the right.

name: hebrew-mem
draw: Hebrew letter mem (מ): a squared shape with a flat base and right wall, a slanted left stroke and a small gap at the bottom left.

name: hebrew-nun
draw: Hebrew letter nun (נ): a narrow backwards C with a short roof, a right stem and a flat base extending left.

name: hebrew-samekh
draw: Hebrew letter samekh (ס): a closed rounded loop with a flat top bar overhanging slightly at the top left.

name: hebrew-ayin
draw: Hebrew letter ayin (ע): two upright strokes in a y shape, the right one long and curving down to the left into a tail along the base.

name: hebrew-pe
draw: Hebrew letter pe (פ): a rounded backwards C open to the left with a small curl hanging inward from its top left corner.

name: hebrew-tsadi
draw: Hebrew letter tsadi (צ): a slanted left stroke and a short right arm joined above a flat base that extends left.

name: hebrew-qof
draw: Hebrew letter qof (ק): a flat roof curving down on the right, with a separate long stem dropping below the baseline on the left.

name: hebrew-resh
draw: Hebrew letter resh (ר): a short roof on a single right leg with a smoothly rounded top right corner.

name: hebrew-shin
draw: Hebrew letter shin (ש): three upright arms joined at a curved base, spreading upward like a crown.

name: hebrew-tav
draw: Hebrew letter tav (ת): a flat roof on a right leg and a left leg that ends in a small foot kicking left.

name: hebrew-final-kaf
draw: Hebrew final kaf (ך): a short flat roof bending into a long vertical stem that drops well below the baseline.

name: hebrew-final-mem
draw: Hebrew final mem (ם): a closed square box with a flat base and a small notch at the top left corner.

name: hebrew-final-pe
draw: Hebrew final pe (ף): a roof with an inward curl at the left joined to a long right stem dropping below the baseline.

name: hebrew-final-tsadi
draw: Hebrew final tsadi (ץ): a short left stroke and a right arm joining a long straight stem that descends below the baseline.

name: arabic-ba
draw: Arabic letter ba (ب): a wide shallow bowl like a canoe open at the top, with one dot centred below it.

name: arabic-ta
draw: Arabic letter ta (ت): the shallow canoe shaped bowl with two dots side by side above it.

name: arabic-tha
draw: Arabic letter tha (ث): the shallow canoe shaped bowl with three dots in a small triangle above it.

name: arabic-jim
draw: Arabic letter jim (ج): a short top stroke folding back into a deep reversed C sweep below, with one dot inside the curve.

name: arabic-hah
draw: Arabic letter hah (ح): a short top stroke folding back into a deep reversed C sweep below, with no dots.

name: arabic-kha
draw: Arabic letter kha (خ): the folded top stroke and deep reversed C sweep with one dot above.

name: arabic-dal
draw: Arabic letter dal (د): a small angular hook: a short slanted stroke that bends at the bottom into a flat base running left.

name: arabic-dhal
draw: Arabic letter dhal (ذ): the small angular dal hook with one dot above it.

name: arabic-ra
draw: Arabic letter ra (ر): a small curved stroke like a large comma sweeping down to the left below the line.

name: arabic-zay
draw: Arabic letter zay (ز): the comma like ra stroke with one dot above it.

name: arabic-sin
draw: Arabic letter sin (س): three small upward teeth in a row that end on the left in a deep round bowl.

name: arabic-shin
draw: Arabic letter shin (ش): the three toothed sin with three dots in a small triangle above the teeth.

name: arabic-sad
draw: Arabic letter sad (ص): a flat closed loop lying on its side with a small tooth, ending on the left in a deep round bowl.

name: arabic-dad
draw: Arabic letter dad (ض): the sad shape of a flat side loop and deep bowl, with one dot above the loop.
